responsibility: This file implements the DFA-based scheduler model for the Sandcraft SR71000/SR3 core. It uses multiple automata to approximate the processor’s buffered out-of-order, multi-unit dispatch behavior with separate CPU, coprocessor, long-latency FP, and integer multiply-accumulate resources, and it defines reservations for integer, memory, branch, coprocessor-transfer, multiply/divide, and floating-point operations so GCC can tune scheduling to the published SR3 latencies and mixed CPU/CP1 execution paths.
